PATCHPAW

A small, normal four-legged calico house cat. Her coat is a patchwork of many small patches in orange, black, white, grey and cream, like a quilt. One front paw is all white, and she has bright green eyes. She wears nothing: no collar, no logo, no emblem of any kind.
WHISK100

A fluffy long-haired house cat with a rich, solid chocolate-brown coat, a white chest and bright green eyes. It has very long, bright white whiskers that fan out wide on both sides of its face and stand out against the dark fur. A normal four-legged house cat that wears nothing.
INGOTLOAF

An ordinary four-legged house cat with a sleek, short, honey-golden coat, a soft metallic sheen and warm orange eyes. It likes to sit in a neat 'cat loaf' pose with its paws tucked under, so its body looks like a small rounded ingot. It wears nothing; no logos or text.
SNOWCURL

A sleek, glossy, solid-white short-haired house cat on four legs, standing in cool garden shade. Its tail is held straight up and curls over at the tip, and one front paw is lifted to its face as if washing. It wears nothing: no collar, badge or logo.
SOCKFOOT

A slim dark-grey tabby shorthair house cat with a white chin and muzzle, a white bib and four white paws that look like socks, and a long striped grey tail held up, walking along a garden path beside the lawn at first light. It wears nothing; the 'socks' are only its white fur.
ROSETTE

A stocky, muscular short-haired house cat with a golden-tan coat covered in black ring-shaped rosette spots. It has a pale cream belly and chin, a thick tail, round golden eyes and nothing worn. It lies stretched along a low oak branch with one front paw dangling.
JELLIECAT
A normal four-legged grey-and-white house cat with grey-green eyes and a crooked grin, one corner of its mouth tucked up, sitting upright on a wooden garden bench. No collar and no accessories.
MOMOTHECAT
A normal four-legged house cat with a shiny, solid black coat and yellow eyes. No markings, clothes or accessories. She sits on a porch step lit by warm garden lanterns at dusk.
LEOTHELION

A sturdy, broad-faced short-haired house cat with a plain warm tawny (sandy golden-brown) coat and no stripes or spots, a pale cream chin and belly, and a thick fluffy ruff of slightly darker tawny fur around the neck. Warm golden eyes, calm and proud. He sits upright on top of an old stone sundial, an ordinary four-legged house cat. He wears nothing. There is no film-strip ring, ribbon, open-mouthed pose, text or logo.
COUCHCAP

A fluffy, medium-long-haired brown tabby cat with a white chest and muzzle, golden-yellow eyes and tufted ears. It sits upright on a grey sofa with one front paw on a small dark TV remote, like a captain at the helm. No logos, watermark or text.
MIGGLES
A fluffy, flat-faced long-haired house cat in a soft smoky grey-taupe coat, with blue-green eyes, a grumpy downturned pout, small tufted ears and slightly darker grey paws. It wears nothing.
PEWTER

A normal four-legged house cat with a light silver-grey tabby coat: darker grey stripes across the cheeks, with softer tabby striping on the head and back, a white muzzle and chin, a pink nose, pink inner ears and grey paws. She lies on her side in a patch of flowering catmint, paws curled and eyes half-closed, content. She wears nothing: no hat and no clothing.
TRINKETCAT

A round, fluffy tortoiseshell house cat (mottled black fur with warm amber and cream patches, green eyes) sitting proudly on a small heap of plain smooth shiny pebbles beside a wooden rain barrel. The pebbles are blank, with no markings, symbols or letters, and the cat wears nothing.
TUPPENCE

A tubby, round-bellied short-haired house cat with a plush, solid blue-grey coat and round copper eyes. It wears a small flat brown tweed cap. It is an ordinary four-legged house cat, waiting politely beside a little garden tea table.
WARMSPOT

A short-haired black-and-white tuxedo cat: a black mask split by a white stripe down the nose, white muzzle, chin and chest, a pink nose and pale eyes. She is curled snugly, on her own, on a warm, plain unmarked round white dish (no logo, no lettering) in the snow. Nothing worn. Always a normal four-legged house cat.
SKEINKIT
A small fluffy cream-coloured kitten with a pink nose and big curious eyes, pawing at a loose ball of red yarn whose strands run between garden posts and flower pots like a web. It wears nothing.
SAVEPAWS

A small, young brown mackerel-tabby house cat (dark brown stripes on a warm brown-grey coat, striped legs and ringed tail) with a cream-white chest and muzzle, big ears and a pink nose, sitting on a flat garden stepping stone with one front paw raised to tap it. It wears nothing: nothing on its head or around its neck, no red yarn, no game controller, no power-button symbol, no logos.
EVERLOOP

A soft, round-faced house cat with a blue-cream coat (dove-grey fur softly mottled with patches of pale cream), curled into a perfect closed ring on the grass, nose tucked into her tail, eyes shut, fast asleep in the sun. Normal four-legged house cat, no collar, no props.
MILKWEED

A fluffy, medium-long-haired, all-white house cat with odd eyes (one blue, one green) and a pink nose. It is crouched mid-pounce in long meadow grass, with seed fluff floating around it. It wears no bow, collar or clothes, and it has a realistic cat face and body. There are no logos and no red-and-yellow colour scheme.
CAMTHECAT

A slim, ordinary four-legged calico house cat, mostly white. A ginger patch covers one ear and that side of the top of her head, the other ear is black, and one front leg is black from the shoulder down. She has a pink nose and pink paw pads. She is a realistic cat, not a round plush toy. She wears nothing, has no tag or label, and sits calmly at the edge of a garden pond.
TUMBLES

A small, normal four-legged kitten with a ginger tabby coat, a white chin and ordinary upright ears, curled up asleep in a garden hammock. A few other kittens can snuggle in beside her. No clothes, no drink, no bottle or can, and no red-and-white colours.
BRACKEN

A sturdy, broad-headed, normal four-legged house cat with a grey-brown striped tabby coat like a wild forest cat. It has a thick, bushy, blunt-ended tail with clear black rings and a black tip, and yellow-green eyes. It creeps low through tall garden ferns. It wears nothing.
TRILLBY

A slim, elegant colourpoint house cat: a pale cream body with a dark seal-brown face mask, ears, paws and tail, and bright blue eyes. Head tilted and mouth open in a friendly chirp. A normal four-legged cat that wears nothing.
LATCHKEY

A sturdy short-haired house cat with a ginger back, head and tail and a white chest, belly and chin, dozing upright on top of a small wooden strongbox with iron bands, eyes half-closed, one front paw resting on an old brass key. An ordinary four-legged cat wearing nothing: no collar, logo, lettering or symbols.
